page.overview:
Who is Madam Bo?

Madam Bo (波夫人) is a minor character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. The owner of the Fengjian Teahouse, Bo is a former associate of the Lin Kuei and the mother of Sektor in the current timeline.

Initially appearing as a minor, non-playable character in the game's Story Mode, Bo made her playable debut as a Kameo Fighter as part of the Kombat Pack 2.

Bo is the owner of the Fengjian Teahouse in Earthrealm, where Kung Lao and Raiden regularly visit, so much so that they have an established friendship with her. She is a former associate of the Lin Kuei as well as the mother of the Lin Kuei armorer Sektor. Bo is initially the martial artist teacher of Kung Lao and Raiden before they are recruited by Liu Kang to become his newest champions.

Bo shares similar characteristics to that of Bo' Rai Cho in the manner of being the initial master of champions later chosen by the Protector of Earthrealm - In the original and alternate timeline, Bo' Rai Cho was the master of Liu Kang and Kung Lao under Raiden, while in the current timeline, it is Raiden and Kung Lao under Liu Kang. She brews her own tea just like Bo' Rai Cho and uses unorthodox means to fighting her opponents, including bashing people with bottles of alcohol and tea or burning them with her cigarettes, which she regularly smokes.
